leadText: Pokémon Adventures: To Catch A Caterpie is the twenty-third monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapters eleven, twelve, and thirteen of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of and . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
